prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic 8K cinematic gym mirror portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original athletic woman with dark hair in a messy sweaty high ponytail, loose strands, pale natural complexion, visible pores, flushed cheeks and tired accomplished expression; wearing a monochromatic pastel-pink gym set with fitted cropped camisole and loose pink sweatpants, plus a thin silver necklace.
prompt.composition_elements: Three-quarter side profile facing left, left hand pressing the mirror and right hand lifting the top hem slightly to inspect a naturally defined midsection; blurred gym equipment, racks, cable machines and dumbbells on black speckled flooring.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm overhead gym lighting creates specular highlights on sweat and hair; intense raw fitness-focused candid mood.
